method: One GET per distinct published image URL, plus one final retry of nine invalid HTTP-200 bodies, at most four workers, 20-second timeout and 8 MB response cap. JPEG/PNG signatures and dimensions checked. Ten visually verified provider notice variants identified by SHA-256 from locally saved audit samples; new notices may differ. Last-Modified over one hour labeled stale; headers are not capture-time proof.
scope: All deduplicated WSDOT Travel Center views included in this catalog
